find: selfTestGeneration += 1; // a load still in flight now builds nothing into a closed pane
killedBy: the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) a close during the load builds no body into the closed pane
the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) a load that fails after the pane closed reports nothing into it
why: Issue #1013. The pane's close stops spending the load's generation, so a load still in flight when Back (or a surface change through `setState`) closes the pane is still current when it lands, and builds the body into a pane nobody is looking at -- or, if the load failed, writes its failure line there.
